Aut.desc: Aut is the junction town on the Mandi–Kullu highway where the road forks into the Parvati Valley (Kasol, Manikaran, Tosh) and the Banjar–Jibhi/Tirthan Valley. It is the entry gate for both valleys and the usual drop-off point for overnight buses from Delhi. (sourced from r/SoloTravel_India travel updates)
